sentences.text: Shri Pramod Choubey - Govt. Advocate for respondent/State.

Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. (new Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Surksha Sanhita, 2023) for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.12/2023 registered at Police Station- Budhar, District-Shahdol (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366 (Ka), 376(2)(n) and 34 of Indian Penal Code, under Section 5(1)/6 of POCSO Act and under Section 3(1)(w-II), 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant could not appear before trial Court on 10.07.2024.
It is submitted that he had gone outside the town for seeking employment.
It is submitted that when applicant learnt about warrant, he surrendered and appeared before trial Court.
He filed an application for cancellation of warrant which was dismissed by the trial Court.
It is submitted that applicant will regularly appear before trial Court.
In these circumstances, applicant may be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:50796 2 MCRC-41975-2024 3.
Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that after grant of bail applicant had violated the condition of bail order, therefore, he may not be released on bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Considering the case of applicant he was released on bail vide order dated 25.05.2023.

On one occasion he could not appear, but thereafter he himself has surrender before Court and file application under Section 72 (2) of B.N.S.S., 2023.
6.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant,
is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
8. C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
